acceptance_criteria: Pinned source, E1 environment, approved proposal/card, expanded 120-candidate registry hash and all frozen tool hashes match before RUNNING.
All 120 fresh candidates are evaluated with at most 20 parameter draws per requested tunnel and 100 native trials per draw; every draw and return is recorded and no seed is appended or substituted.
Every retained parent has all requested tunnels, one connected finite graph/spline bundle, exact cycle rank, required length/vertical span and exact same-seed replay.
No V2 accepted identity matches P01-P05, a V1-valid parent, an M-TARE benchmark identity or another V2 parent.
Each stratum retains its first ten machine-valid candidates and exactly 100 parents form an 80/10/10 parent-disjoint split.
All 100 canonical identities are unique; at least 40 coordinate-free WL hashes exist overall and at least three per stratum.
At least 70 retained parents contain degree>=3 structural events and all 50 3D retained parents have vertical span>=5 m.
Exactly ten maps visualize accepted rank-1 train parents only; validation/development-test remain machine-only.
Mesh, anchor, LiDAR, ray, teacher-label, formal-dataset, training, model, trajectory and M-TARE counts remain zero.
Required manifests, draw traces, log, summary, immutable RUN_STATE and SHA-256 evidence complete within 2 hours and 2 GiB.
baseline: V1 used one parameter draw per requested tunnel and obtained only 60/120 valid candidates; all 60 failures occurred during grown generation. Its successful parents showed 60/60 unique canonical and WL identities, supporting bounded parameter resampling rather than seed hunting or five-template repetition.

estimated_cost.compute: Frozen E1 CPU; 120 native-random candidate constructions and accepted/generated same-seed replay; no mesh, raycasting, GPU, simulator or training.

expected_evidence: Frozen source/tool/environment/approval/registry identities, exact command, raw log, duration, exit code, RUN_STATE and evidence SHA-256
All 120 outcomes and every parameter draw/native API return plus graph/spline artifacts for generated candidates
Accepted 100-parent manifest, 80/10/10 split, predecessor-exclusion, replay, exact-cycle, canonical/WL diversity and structural metrics
Ten complete X-Y/X-Z maps selected only as accepted rank-1 train parents
method: Evaluate all 120 fresh candidates in ten frozen strata. For every requested grown or connector tunnel, draw at most 20 native Cano parameter sets under the candidate topology seed; each draw receives 100 native internal placement trials and the first success is retained. Record every draw and return, require cycle_rank exactly equal to requested connector count, replay every generated candidate, exclude P01-P05 and all 60 V1-valid identities, retain first ten valid per stratum, split ranks 1-8/9/10 as 80 train/10 validation/10 development-test, and render only ten rank-1 train maps. Generate no mesh, LiDAR, labels, dataset samples, models or trajectories.
question: Can bounded deterministic parameter resampling under fresh predeclared seeds produce 100 valid and diverse Cano topology parents while preserving exact family identity?
stop_conditions: Any approval, source, environment, hash, registry, predecessor, scope or output-state mismatch
Any source/system/schema failure that prevents completing the predeclared audit
Any stratum has fewer than ten valid candidates or replay/split/diversity criteria fail
Continuation would require appended seeds, changed draw budget, lowered thresholds, V1-parent reuse or five-template reuse
The run exceeds 7200 seconds or 2 GiB

user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User repeatedly replied 继续 after receiving the exact fresh-seed, 20 parameter-draw, 100 internal-trial, exact-cycle-rank and zero mesh/LiDAR/training V2 scope.
user_authorization.scope: One topology-only V2 audit of 120 fresh predeclared candidates; maximum 20 parameter draws per requested tunnel, 100 Cano internal trials per draw, exact cycle-rank equality, first 10 valid per stratum and 80/10/10 parent split; zero mesh, LiDAR, labels and training.
